claims.text: Midgard wheat imports from Orvan experienced severe declines post-corridor expiration, demonstrating high trade exposure.

citations.quote: In September 2026, the value was USD 38.2M and the volume was 93,000 tonnes.
In September 2025, the value was USD 97.9M and the volume was 272,000 tonnes.

assumptions: Trade reduction directly reflects corridor agreement expiration.

exposure.metric_definition: Year-over-year reduction in wheat import value from Orvan following corridor expiration
assumptions: Corridor expiration drove the monthly YoY deficit.
missing_data: Alternative rail imports not fully captured.
exposure.uncertainty_note: Range depends on whether September 2026 transition month is included.

claims.text: Midgard maize imports dropped substantially following the expiration of delayed delivery terms, leading to high exposure.

citations.quote: In November 2026, the value was USD 31.9M and the volume was 75,000 tonnes.
In November 2025, the value was USD 84.7M and the volume was 223,000 tonnes.

assumptions: Delayed deliveries postponed post-expiration impact until late Q4 2026.

exposure.metric_definition: Year-over-year reduction in maize import value from Orvan post-expiration
assumptions: November-December drop demonstrates full effect after delayed contracts cleared.
exposure.uncertainty_note: Lower bound uses Nov-Dec post-expiration window; upper bound includes October transition.

limitations: Alternative grain sources not factored into gross trade loss.

claims.text: Tolan wheat imports suffered immediate and persistent losses following the end of the Orvan corridor agreement.

citations.quote: In September 2026, the value was USD 17.0M and the volume was 43,000 tonnes.
In September 2025, the value was USD 43.4M and the volume was 124,000 tonnes.

assumptions: Tolan relies heavily on Orvan maritime wheat shipments.

exposure.metric_definition: Year-over-year reduction in wheat import value from Orvan
assumptions: Corridor expiration is primary driver of import fall.
missing_data: Exact Vanir offset numbers not fully itemized.
exposure.uncertainty_note: Depends on inclusion of September 2026 transition month.

limitations: Vanir offset volumes are relatively small.

claims.text: Midgard's post-expiration wheat import decline from Orvan was limited to a net YoY reduction of USD 156.5M to USD 216.2M across the late 2026 months, buffered partly by alternative Vanir exports.

citations.quote: In September 2026, the value was USD 38.2M and the volume was 93,000 tonnes.
Vanir also sells wheat, and some of that supply can reach Tolan and Midgard.

assumptions: Post-expiration disruption is evaluated based on year-over-year changes post-September 2026.
Vanir wheat exports partially offset losses.
limitations: Does not capture exact pricing adjustments or rail freight costs.
estimate removed by code: low -156.5 is greater than high -216.2

claims.text: Midgard's maize import exposure following the Orvan corridor expiration was delayed and limited to between USD 126.4M and USD 128.7M in YoY import reductions due to delayed delivery terms.

citations.quote: The October volume held up longer than the wheat routes because a share of the maize trade was on delayed delivery terms.
In October 2026, the value was USD 62.1M and the volume was 146,000 tonnes.

assumptions: Delayed delivery terms provided a buffer against immediate post-expiration supply drops in October 2026.
limitations: Delayed delivery terms only temporary buffer trade flow.
estimate removed by code: low -126.4 is greater than high -128.7

claims.text: Tolan wheat imports saw moderate post-expiration declines from Orvan, but exposure is mitigated by alternative shipments from Vanir.

citations.quote: Rail loadings through Ravik remain high, and Vanir has increased wheat shipments to Tolan and Midgard.
In September 2026, the value was USD 17.0M and the volume was 43,000 tonnes.

assumptions: Vanir wheat shipments buffer Tolan's import gap.
limitations: Exact low and high range bounds calculation blocked by missing comprehensive trade calculation records for Tolan.

claims.text: Tolan's maize exposure cannot be quantified directly from official trade tables due to absent trade records, representing a major data gap.

citations.quote: Under the agreement, sea exports ran at about 95% of the old normal.

limitations: Complete monthly trade volume and value series for Tolan maize imports from Orvan are missing.
